name: Season May
source:
Welcome to Season May, a virtual world full of Sections, gay furries and the most random/fantastical bull crap you can think of!

Neo, a fox who's constantly bleeding through his ears and nose, drops from a sack in the ceiling and has to find a way to black out the planet of Kalight before everyone dies from... well, existing! Build an exciting team of bizarre nihilistic gay guys and visit every corner of the universe to survive!

[From [url=https://kideshi.itch.io/season-may]Itch.io[/url]]
